# 50.00 CAD deposited and put on the receivable, belonging to no customer.
#
# GnuCash's register takes this: money that arrived is entered against
# Accounts Receivable before anyone knows whose it is. The receivable split is
# in no lot and has no owner, so it is no customer's credit and pays no
# invoice. It is still on the receivable, and something has to say so.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, Assets:Bank +50.00 against
# Assets:Accounts Receivable -50.00, the receivable split in no lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_money_on_the_receivable_nobody_owns_is_listed.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-03-02 * "Deposit, sender unknown"
	guid: "d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 50.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -50.00 CAD
		guid: "e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0e0"
